geometry: Five podium-priced stories across podium + tower land footprints; zero base tower stories; up to 25 amenity-bonus tower-priced stories above the podium (30 stories total).
financial_method: Lower/higher annual NOI retained from financial_inputs_from; construction costs and profit metrics recalculated using current configuration. Implied rents retain current expense assumptions.
preference_method: Independent Dirichlet(alpha=1) weights per color; preserve all identifiers and total; normalize by full snapshot maximum.
pairing: Preferences, financial bounds, and profitable use identical within each color pair.
rounding: Nearest 625 sqft for open space; split remainder evenly, odd block to tower.
limitations: Synthetic financial stress bounds, not market estimates. Existing unit/package limits retained. Whole apartments can leave unused floor area. Bonus-eligible uses may also occupy base floor area under the existing optimizer; FAR is not tracked by floor or use.

catalog.description: Active buildable uses. Scenario constraints are applied at runtime; these are synthetic model inputs.

field_notes.use_family: Coarser group for synthpop voting and dynamic FAR bonuses.
field_notes.program_unit: Unit used when assembling a building program.
field_notes.default_unit_sqft: Area of one dwelling, commercial bay, or facility. For square_foot programs, one unit is one sq ft.
field_notes.minimum_program_sqft: Intrinsic minimum. Scenario minimum housing units are applied separately.
field_notes.maximum_program_sqft: Aggregate maximum for this use across the development. Null for office and lab means no per-use upper limit; runtime bounds follow physical building capacity. Other indoor nonhousing maximum is at most 12000 sq ft; ground-floor and outdoor limits also apply.
field_notes.program_description: Service scope of the selected compact variant; original preference identifiers are retained.
field_notes.example_area_sqft: Typical example total program area; building sq ft or outdoor improved site sq ft. Not a selected development scenario.
field_notes.outdoor: Consumes improved site area instead of indoor floor area.
field_notes.bonus_eligible: Eligible for preference compensation and legacy demand/refund rules.

construction_costs.description: Boston high-end hard construction costs from the RLB Q2 2026 report, plus documented model estimates for other Kendall uses. Soft costs and tower costs are defined in the selected scenario's finance section.
construction_costs.source: Rider Levett Bucknall, North America Quarterly Construction Cost Report, Q2 2026, PDF pages 10-11: https://www.rlb.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2026/06/Q2-2026-QCR_7.7.2026.pdf
construction_costs.location: RLB rows: Boston; estimated rows: Kendall Square/Cambridge proxy
construction_costs.area_unit: RLB building rows: USD per square foot of gross floor area; outdoor model estimates: USD per square foot of improved site area
construction_costs.mapping_notes: Direct Boston high costs, proxies, blends, and model estimates are documented in sources.md. Outdoor rates apply per square foot of improved site area and those groups cannot be placed in a tower. Promoted synthetic housing rates: mid-career, senior, attainable, and luxury housing use hard rates of 410, 420, 350, and 480 USD/sq ft; general housing retains 390. Office and lab construction rates are unchanged.

preferences.description: Complete saved cardinal weight snapshot, including inactive uses. Preserve every identifier.

baseline.limitations: Stabilized model; provisional capitalization rates; negative NOI capitalized as an ongoing liability; simplified common area basis; no financing, vacancy, transaction costs, construction timing, floor-plan packing, or mechanical floors. Valuation is an estimate, not an additional cash receipt. Land excluded unless enabled. Objective choice remains provisional.
